Hi Emma —

Appreciate the clear ask. We've drafted a short mutual action plan (attached) that maps the pilot milestones to a staged conversion offer. High level:

- Extension: we can add a 2-week trial extension AND a $12,000 add-on pilot credit to cover the additional nightly tests.
- MAP milestones (suggested):
  1) Integration & baseline (week 1-2) — verify throughput and nightly batch coverage.
  2) Performance regression & QA (week 3) — confirm latency SLOs and KV cache behavior on representative traffic.
  3) Ramp readiness (week 4) — signoff on export/ingest patterns and run 72hr stability run.
- Conversion pricing: staged discounts tied to committed spend (monthly committed USD):
  - 3-month commit: 5% discount over list
  - 6-month commit: 12% discount + preferential burst capacity
  - 12-month commit: 20% discount + price lock and dedicated support hours

I've attached a one-page MAP and a pricing matrix (CSV) for quick modeling. Rishi/Aisha — tagging you for approval on the credit top-up and the proposed commit ladder + discount bands.

If this works, I can finalize the MAP and send a DocuSign SOW with the extension + credit applied. We can also convert the pricing bands into a quick mutual-commit term sheet (2 pages) if your CFO wants a single number.

Goal: decision by Nov 22 — willing to hop on a short call Thurs if helpful.

Best,

Couple of tweaks to the pricing ladder before we commit:
- Require a minimum committed spend to qualify for the 6/12mo discounts. Propose:$25k/mo minimum for 6mo; $20k/mo minimum for 12mo but with a true-up clause if actual usage exceeds forecast by >30%.

- On SLA: we should offer the standard Platinum response SLA in the SOW for 12mo deals; for 6mo we offer Gold.
